Les Andelys is a Seine River cruise port and a small town (population around 8,000) part of Haute-Normandie (northern France). It is approx 35 km (22 ml) northeast of Evreux (Eure department's capital city).

Les Andelys is divided into 2 parts - Petit-Andely and Grand-Andely. Popular tourist attractions include Chateau Gaillard (13th-century ruined castle), Sainte Clotilde Miraculous Spring (named after the wife of Clovis - Franks' first Christian king), Petit Andely's half-timbered houses.
